html:
A cycle race round France, held each July over about three weeks. It began in 1903 and is the most famous bike race in the world.

It was invented to sell newspapers. The sports paper L'Auto, edited by Henri Desgrange, was in a fight with a rival, and a young writer suggested a race round the whole country. The first Tour had six long stages, some ridden through the night, and was won by Maurice Garin. Sales of the paper soared.

The race grew into a national ritual, climbing the Alps and Pyrenees and ending in Paris. Since 1919 the leader has worn a yellow jersey, the colour of L'Auto's pages. It stopped only during the two world wars. Millions line the roads each year to watch for free, and it is shown worldwide.

It has also had scandals. Doping cases have stained many winners, and in 2012 the American Lance Armstrong was stripped of his seven titles.
sum: A cycle race round France, held each July over about three weeks. It began in 1903 and is the most famous bike race in the world.
